report_summary.main_findings: The patient has a displaced fracture in the left shoulder. In the left leg, there is a steel plate seen in situ.
report_summary.patient_explanation: The patient, AYUSH KUMAR, underwent a left shoulder surgery last year involving a fracture and plate insertion. He also had a left leg surgery involving a steel plate. The scan (CT scan) shows the presence of steel plates within the left leg bone, indicating previous orthopedic surgery. Further details are provided in the medical report.
report_summary.diagnosis: Displaced Fracture (Left Shoulder), Steel plate in situ (Left Leg)
report_summary.recommendations: Follow-up with the orthopedic surgeon is recommended for monitoring the fracture healing and overall recovery. Based on the findings, orthopedic treatment is likely needed.
